Here's a fix that barely changes the way it looks, but IMO provides a big improvement to usability:

.sr-list {
 margin: 0;
}

whoaSubscriptionMenu > li > a {
 padding-left: 5px;
}

whoaSubscriptionMenu > li > ul {
